en-US.label: Callflow Simulator
en-US.description: Test any call against an account's callflows and follow the path it takes.
en-US.extended_description: Choose a phone number, a callflow or the entire account to get an interactive diagram of how Kazoo handles its calls: time-of-day rules, IVR menus, ring groups, queues, call forwarding, voicemail and jumps between callflows. Run a test call for any date and time, choose menu keys, listen to greetings and hold music, and catch misconfigurations (deleted references, steps that can never run, rules Kazoo cannot evaluate) before your customers run into them.
features: Interactive diagram for a number, a callflow or the entire account
Test calls for any date and time, using Kazoo's own time-of-day logic
IVR menus shown as a keypad: choose keys to follow the call
Listen to greetings, hold music and Kazoo's built-in voicemail prompt
Phone registration status and plain-language settings for every step
Flags misconfigurations; PDF export for people without a login
